caption: The video captures red and white fluid against a black void. A red filament arcs across the scene, thickened into a crown-like blob at its left end and joined at its right to a white cluster fringed by red tendrils, while a lower-left band and droplets scatter around it. As the motion continues, the whole assembly drifts downward, the droplet field thinning toward the top until the upper half opens into empty black. The left crown flattens into a thinner stream, so the arc straightens as it descends. The lower-left band slides out at the bottom, and the right cluster shifts toward the bottom-right corner, partly cut off. The left crown and right cluster drift apart as they fall, so the assembly stretches horizontally rather than translating as one piece, leaving the splashes suspended.
